skillset.skill: 12s CT - 3000% Fire DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 10%.
skillset.arts: 25000% Fire DMG (PHY). Heals own Status ailments (except Faint, Paralysis, Seal, Freeze). For 20s, increase all allies' Paralysis RES & Freeze RES by 100%.
skillset.truearts: 30000% Fire DMG (PHY). Each time True Arts is used, increase Break Power of this True Arts by 5000 (MAX: 30000). When Super Arts is used, resets the Break Power of this True Arts back to 5000.
skillset.superarts: 180000% Fire DMG (PHY). Each time Super Arts is used, increase the DMG Multiplier of this Super Arts by an additional 180000% (MAX: 540000%). When Arts or True Arts is used, resets the DMG Multiplier of this Super Arts back to 180000%.

passive.ability1: Tyrant of Destruction: When not affected by Status ailments, increase own DMG and Break Power by 50%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability3: Increase own Arts by 200 at start of quest.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Combat Form Milim's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Combat Form Milime's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Milim's Armor
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 6000% Fire DMG (MAG). For 15s, increase own Fire DMG by 50%. If user is Demon, increase own Fire DMG by 80% instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Combat Form Milim, increase own Status RES (except Faint) by 30% and Arts by 2/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
